title: 第15章 雾霾之中三第16章 大酒庄第一个据点
slug: 领主我在苦痛世界养成少女
content_zh:
菲尔德露出春风般和睦的表情道“那你们应该是护送我们的，对吧？就像骑士精神说的那样，赞美女武神。”
康纳狂喜，暗想菲尔德不知道他的目的，立刻借坡下驴道“啊对对对。”
“那太好了，快下马过来喝杯小麦酒，我们正要出发，这一路你有展现骑士精神的时候。”菲尔德抬手示意阿诗娜退后，随后若无其事请骑兵们喝酒。
众骑兵磨磨蹭蹭，心虚的同时，又抱有侥幸心理。
此时硬刚神选者八成会全军覆没，逃跑也不可能，阿诗娜在击倒康纳的同时，便抢走了驱雾灯。没有驱雾灯撞进死亡雾霾之中，就是送死。
“看来男爵没发现我们的打算。”
“也是，菲尔德向来愚蠢。”
众人见菲尔德面色诚恳，想到了他之前的善良软弱，心中都开始抱有幻想。
被菲尔德劝下马后，他们紧张地灌了几口小麦酒，悬着的心才放下。
“大人，我想我们该回去复命了。”康纳找借口要开溜。
菲尔德差点没绷住，这伙脑残真把自己当傻子骗。
“你们的战马被我征用来拓货了，等到了夜幕领在还给你们。”菲尔德敷衍地拒绝，随后指指队伍的前方，“你刚才说，要帮我们开路来着，走吧，去开路。”
康纳突感不妙，立刻着急起来“我后悔了，很抱歉，但我必须快点回去复命，我想伯爵已经等急了。”
“呵呵，我看你们是完全不懂哦~”菲尔德冷笑一声，冲着阿诗娜做出示意。
“噗嗤！”
阿诗娜的巨狼一口咬住一名骑兵的脑袋，咔嚓~咔嚓~令人牙酸的咀嚼声几乎将所有人的呼吸声淹没，失去脑袋士兵血如泉涌，倒在地上，突然的袭击，让他的身体疯狂抽搐。。
众人，甚至连菲尔德的领民们也下意识屏住呼吸，恐惧不已。
这场面太残暴了。
“我错了！菲尔德男爵！”康纳果断认怂，扑倒在地，“是你的二姐，丽兹命令我做的。”
“还要我说第二遍吗？康纳队长。”菲尔德笑眯眯地回答，“前面探路，或者现在就去死。”

冷！康纳只感觉冷到了骨子里。
什么骨子里的温良，都是狗屁！以前听其他贵族闲聊，说菲尔德就像小绵羊一样软弱。
啊呸！都是骗子！康纳狠狠诅咒了那些骗子。
在卫兵们长戟的威胁下，很快十八名没有战马的骑兵，组成了小方阵，走在了队伍的最前方。
而菲尔德的小地图显示，前方有大片的腐尸在飞速靠近。
长呼一口气，菲尔德咬牙“出发！。”
content_en:
Field showed an expression as harmonious as the spring breeze and said, "Then you should be escorting us, right? Just like the spirit of chivalry says, praise the Valkyrie."
Connor was ecstatic, thinking that Field didn't know his purpose, so he immediately said, "Ah, right, right."
"That's great. Get off your horse and come over and have a glass of wheat wine. We are about to set off. It's time for you to show your chivalry spirit along the way." Field raised his hand to signal Asuna to step back, and then treated the cavalrymen to a drink as if nothing had happened.
The cavalrymen dilly-dallyed, feeling guilty and taking chances.
At this time, the Chosen Ones would most likely be wiped out, and escape would be impossible. Asuna snatched away the fog light while knocking down Connor. If you don’t have fog lights and crash into the death haze, you will die.
"It seems that the Baron didn't notice our plan."
"Yes, Field has always been stupid."
Seeing Field's sincere expression, everyone thought of his previous kindness and weakness, and began to have illusions in their hearts.
After being persuaded by Field to dismount, they nervously drank a few sips of wheat wine before letting go of their suspense.
"Sir, I think we should go back and recover." Connor made an excuse to run away.
Field almost couldn't hold his breath. These idiots really deceived themselves as fools.
"I have requisitioned your war horses to expand supplies. I will return them to you at night." Field refused perfunctorily, then pointed to the front of the team, "You just said that you wanted to help us clear the way. Come on, go and clear the way."
Connor suddenly felt something bad and immediately became anxious, "I regret it. I'm sorry, but I have to go back and recover quickly. I think the earl is already waiting in a hurry."
"Haha, I think you guys don't understand it at all~" Field sneered and gestured to Asuna.
"Pfft!"
Ashina's giant wolf bit a cavalryman's head in one bite. The sour chewing sound almost drowned out everyone's breathing. The soldier who lost his head fell to the ground with blood gushing out like a fountain. The sudden attack made his body twitch crazily. .
Everyone, even the citizens of Field, subconsciously held their breaths in fear.
This scene is too brutal.
"I was wrong! Baron Field!" Connor gave in decisively and threw himself to the ground. "It was your second sister, Liz, who ordered me to do it."
"Do you want me to say it a second time? Captain Connor." Field replied with a smile, "Explore the way ahead, or die now."
Cold! Connor felt cold to the core.
All the gentleness in the bones is bullshit! I used to hear other nobles chatting and saying that Field was as weak as a little sheep.
Ah bah! They are all liars! Connor cursed the liars hard.
Under the threat of the guards' halberds, eighteen cavalrymen without horses soon formed a small square formation and walked at the front of the team.
Field's small map showed that there were large amounts of rotting corpses approaching rapidly ahead.
Taking a long breath, Field gritted his teeth and "Let's go!"
